The incumbent is responsible for day-to-day operation and supervision of the EXPLORER PET/CT clinical and research programs located at the EXPLORER Molecular Imaging Center (EMIC). The incumbent should have a knowledge of medical imaging facility operations, including departmental research and clinical workflows, compliance policies, safety and regulatory requirements and quality control procedures. Incumbent is responsible for staffing, work procedures, quality of work, customer service, labor relations, short-term planning, problem solving and process improvements for the PET imaging operations of the Center. The incumbent is responsible for educational and training oversight of Medical Office Service Coordinators (MOSC), Research Data Analyst and financial and administrative functions. This position is responsible for supervision of radiology scheduling and reception staff members at the hospital, Lawrence Ellison Ambulatory Care Center, and multiple UCDH clinic locations. Works directly with the Center’s Directors, Operations Manager, and the NM Division Chief (or their designees) to maintain, standardize and optimize workflow Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
60% - Supervisor /Administrative Responsibilities

As an independent working supervisor, this position oversees various radiology scheduling and reception duties, which includes ensuring current and appropriate scheduling and reception standards are adhered to; ensuring team members have the necessary skills and training to successfully interact with patients, staff, faculty, and other radiology customers; successfully aiding in the implementation and training of staff when new technology or tools are introduced to the department; work collaboratively with department supervisors and managers on projects and changing needs/demands; identifying opportunities for process improvement that benefit, staff, faculty, patients, or other customers; appropriately utilize resources to ensure staffing demands are met daily at EMIC; and maintain personal and staff focus on consistently providing excellent customer service. Must exercise initiative, originality, and independent judgement in resolving any problems pertaining to radiology scheduling and reception needs. The candidate must be able to appropriately and professionally address complaints from physicians, patients, or staff.
20% - Patient Scheduling, Support and Management
10% - Research Administration /Project Support, and Data Collection
Thorough understanding of human subjects’ protections and the regulations governing the research highly preferred. Familiarity with biomedical research highly preferred.

Strong oral and written communication skills to create and initiate error free documents, including writing and editing skills to compose and proofread letters, financial statements, budget reports and other assigned documents, and to articulate information in a clear, concise, and visually attractive manner, creating error-free documents.
Management skills to oversee administrative operations of a center.

Positive attitude toward responsibilities, faculty and co-workers, and demonstrated ability to interact in a helpful, effective, and informative manner with a wide variety of people, using tact and diplomacy.
Knowledge of FMLA, CFRA, FEHA, ADA, worker’s compensation, pregnancy leave and other types of leaves of absence.
Ability to interact with confidence and retain confidential information.
Knowledge of UCDH policies and procedures preferred.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively as a team member and promote a cohesive team environment.
Budget, accounting, and finance skills to provide support to the finance manager, approve UC Path actions for finance and perform HR duties.
Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly convey information and ideas through a variety of media to diverse audiences.
Knowledge of AggieService, Cognos, UCPath, BEATS, AggieBuy, AggieTravel and other University-related systems preferred.
Strong qualitative and quantitative analytical skills with the ability to extract and diagnose data.
